name: Lavaridge Town
lines:
You’ve come all the way to look
at herbal medicine in Lavaridge?
That’s rather commendable!
I like you! Take this!

That Charcoal I gave you is used
for making herbal medicine.
It can also do wonders when held
by a Pokémon.
It powers up Fire-type moves!

Herbal medicine works impressively well.
But your Pokémon will dislike you for it.
It must be horribly bitter!

The display reads:
The more bitter it tastes, the better it works!
